claim: The campaign dataset had data-entry slips where the same real player was logged twice in one squad under different roles
Young Boys 2024-25 had 'Sandro Lauper' listed as both CB and DM
Young Boys 2024-25 had 'Joël Monteiro' listed as both RM and ST
The duplicates were found via a scripted scan
The draft's build() function is located at index.html line 3283
build() turned each raw row into its own candidate card without deduplicating by name
The same player could be drafted once as each role into two different slots due to the lack of deduplication
build() now merges duplicate name entries within a campaign into a single player
The merge unions eligible positions/groups from duplicate entries
The merge keeps the higher rating when duplicate entries exist
A scripted scan verified that 0 campaigns now contain duplicate names after the fix
Merged entries correctly gained combined position eligibility instead of splitting into two cards
